name: FURSONA MAKER 3!!!
source:
"Aren't fursonas great?! Why don't you create your own in FURSONA MAKER 3?!

-Variety of colors

-4 different tails

-Story mode!

Delve into this fantastic world!"

[From [url=https://mdos79.itch.io/not-fursona-maker-3]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「獸設超棒的，對吧？！要不就來《獸設製作器3》做個你自己的獸設？！

•多種顏色可選

•四種不同的尾巴

•還有故事模式！

快一頭扎進這個奇妙的世界吧！」
